pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark brown regions exhibit irregular polygonal geometries with rounded, smooth pixel gradients at the edges. Patches are closely packed on the upper neck and become more widely spaced with softened corners on the mid-flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light cream-colored pathways separating the patches. Pathways show variable pixel thickness and meet at clearly defined tri-radiate and quadri-radiate junction nodes.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette is visible along the dorsal mane of the neck against the sky, showing fine vertical hair extensions.
dorsal_ridge_profile.contour_gaps: A structural break in the continuous mane line is observed at the posterior base of the neck, where the serrated silhouette transitions to a smoother profile.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: A prominent circular region of dark, irregular pigmentation and textural disruption is visible on the upper-mid flank, interrupting the standard geometric pattern of the pelage.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of a localized, dark, circular lesion on the upper flank area that disrupts the local patch symmetry.
